summary: Tested 'Merek Unggulan' on each branch store page (backend + UI at 390x844). Backend: 14/14 pass in the new pytest file, and the 10 iter74 regression tests still pass. GET /api/stores/pgs-jombang/featured-brands gives the automatic top 10 by product count, sorted, 'No Brand' left out, no _id. It returns [] for Toko Satu (marketplace seller) and for an unknown id. Auth: 401 without a token. Jombang admin gets 403 on pgs-jember and customer gets 403. Super Admin gets 403 on a non-official id. Jombang admin GET shows custom=false while automatic. PUT keeps the order, drops unknown ids and removes duplicates, and does not change Jember or the Beranda list. [] hides the row and returns []. null goes back to automatic. Super Admin can edit pgs-jember. A wrong type or more than 30 ids returns 422. GET /store-appearance for jombang lists only pgs-jombang. UI: Jombang admin card cm-featured shows the 'Belum diatur' auto list with no store chips. up/down/remove/search/add (Suggo) and save work ('Merek Unggulan disimpan'), the API matches the new order, and cm-feat-auto appears. /shop/pgs-jombang shows the custom row; Suggo shows the initial 'S'; Kimplast, Apollystar and Advance show logos. Tapping featured-brand-Kimplast opens /brand/Kimplast with Jombang prices. /shop/pgs-jember and Beranda still show the automatic list. Toko Satu has no row. Super Admin sees chips sa-store-pgs-official/jombang/jember. Saving Jember changes only Jember. Switching to the Jombang chip loads Jombang's own list. Saving an empty list hides the row on /shop/pgs-jombang. The catalog-master Unggulan tab still works and changes only Beranda, not the pgs-official store page. cm-feat-auto works in both places. After saving, the sa-preview in-app navigation shows the new order. Final state: every store and Beranda are back to automatic, and no featured_brands docs are left in app_settings.

minor.issue: Super Admin with a non-official or unknown store id gets 403 'Anda hanya bisa mengatur tampilan toko Anda sendiri'. A 404 'Toko tidak ditemukan' would be clearer.

In custom mode, brands with 0 priced products in that branch are still returned (count 0). Tapping one opens an empty brand page. Consider filtering out count==0 or warning in the editor. Auto mode also runs a full aggregation over about 6.6k products on every call, with no cache; the component fetches twice on mount (useEffect + useFocusEffect).

issues: The Merek Unggulan card has its own 'Simpan Merek Unggulan' button, separate from 'Simpan tampilan' just below it. The intro text only mentions 'banner, logo, info, dan produk andalan'. Add a note that brands are saved separately, or mention it in the intro, so admins don't press the wrong button.
The add-search results show the global product count (from /api/brands), not the branch count, while the auto list is ranked by branch count.

action_items: (LOW) Return 404 instead of 403 when Super Admin targets a non-official or unknown store in /store-appearance/{id}/featured-brands.
(LOW) Hide or flag custom brands that have 0 products in the branch.
(LOW) Make it clear on Tampilan Toko that Merek Unggulan is saved with its own button.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings are keyed by store (app_settings 'featured_brands:<sid>'), separate from the Beranda key. Checked: the Beranda and pgs-official store page lists are independent.
In auto mode cm-feat-save is enabled with no changes (dirty includes !custom), so saving freezes the auto list as a custom one. Same as iter74; this is intended per the help text.
seed_data_creation: None. Featured-brand settings were changed temporarily for jombang and jember (and Beranda), then all set back to automatic with PUT items null. Checked: no featured_brands docs left.

Use page.request for API checks inside the browser (urllib gets 403 from the edge). Run pytest with -n0 and EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported. Marketplace store id: Toko Satu st_c789b1a7c3.
